title: What Outcome RL Buys: Finishing, Reliability, Rarely Reach
abstract: arXiv:2610.34894v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Outcome RL raises pass@1 but not pass@k at large k (Yue et al., 2025). But every pass@1 is scored under a token budget. Every recipe also trains under one. On physics and math problems at fixed token budgets, we compare the pass@1 of 20 released RL models (1.5B to 32B) with that of the thinking models they started from. We ask whether each pass@1 gain is changed behaviour or new knowledge. We divide each change in pass@1 into three parts. Finishing measures answering before the budget runs out. Reliability measures being right once finished. Reach measures problems RL solves that its base answered wrongly in all eight tries, minus problems the base solves that RL answered wrongly in all eight. We find four things. (1) Where the base often hits the token budget before answering, most of the change, gain or loss, is finishing (82% at 4k and 8k). translated_title: 结果导向强化学习买到了什么：完成度、可靠性、以及很少的触达
translated_abstract: 结果导向强化学习提升了pass@1，却无法在大k值下提升pass@k（Yue et al., 2025）。但每个pass@1都是在token预算限制下评分的，每个训练配方也都是在token预算下训练的。在固定token预算的物理和数学问题上，我们比较了20个已发布的RL模型（1.5B到32B）与其出发的思维模型的pass@1。我们探究每个pass@1的提升究竟来自行为的改变还是新知识。我们将pass@1的每个变化分解为三个部分：完成度衡量在预算耗尽前给出答案；可靠性衡量在完成作答后答对；触达衡量RL解决了基础模型在八次尝试中全部答错的问题数，减去基础模型解决了而RL在八次尝试中全部答错的问题数。我们发现了四件事：（1）在基础模型经常在给出答案前就用尽token预算的情况下，大部分变化——无论增益还是损失——都是完成度（在4k和8k下占82%）；给定更多token，基础模型自己就能弥补大部分完成度差距。（2）在基础模型有足够……
tldr: 该论文将结果导向强化学习带来的pass@1提升分解为完成度、可靠性和触达三部分，发现在固定token预算下RL的大部分收益其实来自“完成度”（即在预算内给出答案），而真正解决基础模型无法解决的新问题的“触达”很少。
en_tdlr: This paper decomposes outcome RL's pass@1 gains into finishing, reliability, and reach, showing that under fixed token budgets most of RL's gains come from "finishing" (answering within the budget), while "reach"—solving genuinely new problems the base model cannot—remains rare.
